seoTitle: Hawaii Public Schools Calendar 2026-2027: Start Date, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the Hawaii public schools 2026-2027 calendar from the official HIDOE source, including first day, last day, holidays, breaks, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The Hawaii State Department of Education 2026-2027 school calendar lists August 3, 2026 as the first day for students and May 27, 2027 as the last day for students. Fall Break runs October 5-9, 2026, Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027, and Spring Break runs March 15-19, 2027. The calendar includes 180 student days, 189 teacher days, state holidays, Election Day, a January 4 teacher workday, and an institute day window during February 8-12.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hawaii public school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Hawaii public school students start the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 5 through Friday, October 9, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there a Hawaii DOE multitrack calendar for 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. HIDOE publishes a separate 2026-2027 Holomua Elementary multitrack calendar, linked as an alternate calendar on this page.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Hawaii public schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

customSections.label: Quick Summary
customSections.content: Key planning points for the 2026-2027 HIDOE calendar: students have 180 scheduled instructional days, the year follows the statewide traditional calendar structure, major breaks include Fall, Winter, and Spring Break, and some schools may publish separate multitrack or school-specific dates.

customSections.label: Hawaii Public Schools Calendar Important Dates for Families
customSections.content: Families usually check the Hawaii public schools calendar first for the first day of school, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, state holidays, institute day windows, teacher workdays, and the last day of school. These dates affect childcare, interisland travel, mainland travel, after-school programs, work schedules, and summer camp planning.
